about.text: A small, soft fresh goat cheese from the Val Vigezzo in Piedmont, 300 g to 1 kg, with a thin rind. Pasteurised goat's milk is set with lactic cultures and rennet, the curd is cut, drained, turned and dry-salted; it is ready after salting or can be ripened 3 to 4 months.

sources.text: Milk, process, area and ageing, from this article.
